sourceCatalog.audio: 1 x Speaker / Amplifier Out (Hi-Z 70V/100V or Low-Z 4/8Ω); Hi-Z mode: 1× 240W @ 70V/100V, mono bridged | Low-Z mode: 2× 120W @ 4/8Ω, stereo | THD+N; The AMP-2120-DNT is a compact 240W dual-mode amplifier designed for professional AV installations. It supports 70V/100V Hi-Z speaker systems or 4/8Ω Low-Z speaker loads, delivering up to 240W mono or 2×120W stereo from a half-rack, 1RU chassis. Built-in DSP provides EQ, filters, dynamics, delay, limiting, and matrix mixing for clear speech and optimized playback. With dual combo XLR/TRS mic inputs, 48V phantom power, automatic paging mute, LAN, Telnet, RS-232, and secure web GUI control, it integrates easily into classrooms, conference rooms, and multipurpose spaces.; 1× hardware trigger input — auto-mutes speaker output on paging; DSP; EQ; Delay

Built-in DSP provides EQ, filters, dynamics, delay, limiting, and matrix mixing for clear speech and optimized playback. With dual combo XLR/TRS mic inputs, 48V phantom power, automatic paging mute, LAN, Telnet, RS-232, and secure web GUI control, it integrates easily into classrooms, conference rooms, and multipurpose spaces.; Supports LAN (TCP/IP), Telnet, RS-232, hardware trigger, and front-panel push buttons for complete integration flexibility. name: Advanced 1 or 2 Channel Dante Amplifier with support for Low and High Impedance Speaker Systems - WyreStorm
title: Advanced 1 or 2 Channel Dante Amplifier with support for Low and High Impedance Speaker Systems - WyreStorm
description: The AMP-2120-DNT is a compact, professional-grade amplifier designed for maximum flexibility in modern AV environments. Supporting both 70V/100V high-impedance or 4/8Ω low-impedance speaker loads, it delivers up to 240W of power in mono or 2x120W in stereo. Built-in DSP provides advanced audio processing—including gain, EQ, filters, dynamics, delay, and mixing—ensuring crystal-clear speech and optimized playback for any application. With flexible analog inputs, Dante connectivity, and intuitive control options via...

salesLanguage.headline: APO-210-UC: improves the meeting experience for people in and outside the room
salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when the room needs to support video meetings, shared audio, cameras, microphones or BYOM/BYOD collaboration.
salesLanguage.customerValue: It helps make the meeting feel joined-up: people can be seen, heard and shared with more reliably than using loose laptop accessories.
salesLanguage.realWorldApplication: Huddle rooms, boardrooms, classrooms and hybrid meeting spaces.
salesLanguage.salespersonCue: Ask what the remote participant needs to see and hear, then position the product around that experience.
talkTrack: It is about the meeting workflow, not only the hardware.
It helps remove friction around camera, microphone, speaker and USB connectivity.
It should be selected when conferencing is part of the use case.
discoveryPrompts: Which meeting platform is being used?
Do users bring their own laptop, use a room PC, or both?
What camera, microphone and speaker coverage does the room need?
positioningNotes: Use for UC-led rooms where audio, camera or USB device behaviour matters.
avoidPositioningAs: Do not lead with UC products for simple video switching if there is no conferencing requirement.
marketApplications: Camera, speakerphone, microphone and BYOM/BYOD meeting workflows

name: Add-On Microphone for Apollo Video Bar - WyreStorm
title: Add-On Microphone for Apollo Video Bar - WyreStorm
description: Add-On microphone for use with the Apollo VX20 video bar. Connect this mic to expand the pickup range in your meeting spaces. Connects to the VX20 via an included USB cable. The APO-COM-MIC can be cascaded up to 3 times. For longer extension requirements the APO-MIC-EXT ethernet extender can be used.

dependencies: A compatible display is required on the HDMI output
Where wireless casting is required, confirm the APO-DG2 dongle or supported casting path is quoted
sourceCatalog.quoteWarnings: The v2 product page claims compatibility with Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR), e.g. Lenovo ThinkSmart Core Gen 1/2. This is a compatibility claim, not a certification statement - confirm Teams Rooms certification status and test the room before install when quoting a Teams deployment. Inputs are capped at 4K@30Hz, and the HDMI input is HDCP 1.4 only. Confirm before quoting against a 4K60 or HDCP 2.2 source requirement. The two HDMI outputs are not equivalent - output 1 is 4K@60 HDCP 2.3, output 2 is 4K@30 HDCP 2.2. Confirm which display is on which. The camera is ePTZ (digital), not mechanical PTZ, with a fixed-focus lens. Confirm this suits the room rather than assuming optical zoom. The HDMI input supports HDCP 1.4 only. A protected 4K source requiring HDCP 2.2 will not pass through it. Input and output maxima differ. It is easy to quote this as a '4K60 bar' when only one output reaches 4K60 and no input does.

description: DISCONTINUED Bringing the wealth of knowledge that WyreStorm has accumulated in hybrid HDMI cables, the DAOC brings the same powerful benefits to DisplayPort system topology. Connecting to PC graphics cards or high performance media playback systems, the DAOC is ready for content up to 8K/60 at 8-bit 4:4:4 plus support for HDR-10. The WyreStorm DAOC can extend super high-bandwidth video with up to 32 channels of PCM audio up to 10m/33ft using the very latest in active optical transmission technology.

title: 15 Meter USB 3.2 GEN 2 10Gbps Active Optical Extension Cable - WyreStorm
description: The CAB-UAOC-15 is an active optical cable supporting extension of USB signals ranging from 2.0 up to the 3.2 Gen 2 spec, meaning this cable can support 10Gbps at a distance of 15 meters (50ft). The CAB-UAOC-15 is great for connection of remote USB devices such as PTZ cameras, interactive touchscreens or smartboards, audio/video extension or simply high-speed data transfer over long distances. With the USB Male to USB Female design, you can connect and extend practically any USB peripheral device in seconds.

title: USB-C Active Optical Cable (15m/49ft) - WyreStorm
description: The CAB-USBC-15 is an active optical USB-C to C cable capable of transmitting A/V and data 15m/49ft. USB data is rated up to Superspeed 5Gbps for fast file transfers or connecting USB 3.0 equipped devices such as conference cameras. The CAB-USBC-15 also supports Alt-Mode which allows 4K30 video to be transmitted from USB-C laptops or mobile devices. Pair this cable with a WyreStorm Apollo or presentation switcher to take advantage of the 60W power delivery so you can keep your device charged while you present.

salesLanguage.headline: EX-100-KVM: gets the signal from one place to another without moving the equipment
salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when the source, display, USB device or control point is too far away for a simple local cable.
salesLanguage.customerValue: It lets the room be built around where people and displays need to be, rather than where short cables happen to reach.
salesLanguage.realWorldApplication: Displays away from the rack, lecterns, teaching rooms, meeting rooms and point-to-point signal paths.
salesLanguage.salespersonCue: Start with distance and what has to travel: video only, video plus USB, audio, control or network.
talkTrack: It solves a distance problem.
If USB is included, it can support cameras, touch displays, keyboards, mice or conferencing peripherals.
It is usually simpler than AV-over-IP when the path is one source to one display.
discoveryPrompts: How far is the source from the display or USB device?
What signals need to travel over the same path?
Is this a single fixed route or does it need to switch between many destinations?
positioningNotes: Best for defined point-to-point paths.
avoidPositioningAs: Do not use an extender as a routing system when many sources and many displays need flexible switching.
marketApplications: Long-distance video, USB, control and network transport

sourceCatalog.resolutionBandwidth: 4K AI camera
sourceCatalog.audio: Now Zoom certified, hold a smooth and productive video conference with the HALO VX10 v2 video bar. It integrates a 4K wide-angle AI camera, dual powerful stereo speaker and a beamforming four-microphone array into one device, offering you extraordinary audio and video experience. With its outstanding functions and exquisite design, HALO VX10 v2 is ideal for small meeting room, huddle room as well as home office.; Whether you work from home or in your company’s meeting room, HALO VX10 v2 video bar is your best choice! It is integrated with one 4K AI camera, dual powerful stereo speaker and four noise-cancelling microphones, meeting all your needs for a smooth and productive video conference.; You can also enable the unique speaker tracking mode on “WyreStorm HALO” software when in your company’s meeting room. The camera can automatically pick out the active speaker from your team and ensure the speaker’s image remains in the center. It provides a natural flow to the conversation, allowing the far end to see the speaker and body language better.

sourceCatalog.quoteWarnings: This is a HYBRID matrix: it has HDMI, HDBaseT 3.0 AND NetworkHD 500 outputs. Confirm which transport each display uses - do not assume all outputs are the same type. The NetworkHD 500 spill-over port ties this into an AVoIP system. Confirm the wider NetworkHD design if that path is used. Dante 4x4 needs an audio network and clock/domain ownership confirmed on site. 10 inputs include 1 USB-C and 1 HDBaseT and 1 NetworkHD - only 7 are plain HDMI. Confirm the source mix. Unlike a plain matrix, outputs are mixed-transport (4x HDMI, 2x HDBaseT, 1x NetworkHD). Treat each output path on its own terms when designing displays.

description: Consumer HDMI content is now breaking through the once comfortable HDBaseT ‘ceiling’ of 10Gbps, with HFR (High Frame Rate). This receiver is exclusively used for MXV-0606-H2A-70 & MXV-0808-H2A-70 Matrix solutions.

sourceCatalog.quoteWarnings: Compatibility is documented for the NHD-100, 120 and 150 series. It is NOT listed as compatible with the 500 or 600 series - confirm before designing it into a 500/600 system. Maximum is 4K@30Hz on both NDI and NHD paths. Confirm against any 4K60 requirement. This is a stream gateway with no HDMI connectors - it converts between NDI and NetworkHD on the network, and does not take a local source. Has no HDMI ports at all. Both its input and output are network streams, so it cannot accept a local HDMI source or drive a display directly. The specification table states 20V DC 1A and PoE, while the feature list states PoE 802.3af. Confirm the required PoE class before relying on switch power.

sourceCatalog.quoteWarnings: Confirm the switch supports the required multicast configuration for NetworkHD 500. The 5120-wide resolutions are 4:2:0 CVT, not 4:4:4. Confirm before quoting against an ultra-wide 4:4:4 requirement. Confirm whether the SFP or the RJ45 network path is being used; the SFP options determine the fibre type and distance. Published revision is v2 (official page 'NHD-500-TX/RX v2'); no public v3 exists. Templates quote NHD-500-RX at the v2 spec. Re-review if a v3 is released. Encoding is JPEG 2000 at up to 850Mbps, which is visually lossless but not mathematically lossless. Do not present it as uncompressed.

The “E” variations remove some of the I/O found on the standard encoder and decoder and retain only the core functionalities that suite most applications. Engineered for installations requiring pixel-perfect 4K60 4:4:4 video with zero-frame latency, this series supports robust 10GbE network operation with PoE+ power and a flexible AV control suite.; Built on a 10GbE SDVoE network backbone, the 600-E enables reliable AV distribution across point-to-point and matrix-based systems. Integrated support for network-based control allows IR and RS-232 signals to be transmitted alongside video and audio, ensuring compatibility with third-party control platforms and automation systems.; Compatible with the 802.3at PoE+ protocol, the 610s can power from a compatible network switch removing the need to use cumbersome DC power supplies.; The compact, installer-friendly enclosure is ideal for rack mounting or discreet AV cabinet placement. Use this when sources and displays are spread out, the customer needs flexible routing, or the system may grow over time.

It is not automatically the best option for every multi-display room.

sourceCatalog.networkRequirement: 1x 10GbE 8-Pin RJ45; LAN; 1x 1GbE 8-pin RJ45 (Auxiliary Lan); The NetworkHD 610-TX expand the functionality of the powerful SDVoE 600 series product line. The 610-TX retain many of the capabilities found on the other models, such as full HDMI 2.0 encoding, zero latency transmissions, video wall and multiview processing. However, the 610 packs an extra punch by incorporating a Dante/AES67 output, allowing audio from the HDMI or analog audio input to transmit to Dante/AES67 enabled amplifiers, DSP or mixers. The TX is also equipped with a full speed USB 1.1 HID chipset, maximizing compatibility with thousands of USB peripherals for extension over the network, such as a keyboard/mouse & touchscreens, or just simple data transfers.; The NHD-610-TX is equipped with a 2CH Dante audio transmitter. Audio from either the HDMI or analog audio input can be sent over the network using Dante protocols for a latency free and lossless delivery to compatible audio equipment. We’ve also made sure AES67 is supported to expand compatibility with even more audio receivers.; All 600 series components support encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG. Most HDMI content is transmitted completely uncompressed and delivered over the network latency free using genlock synchronization.; Compatible with the 802.3at PoE+ protocol, the 610s can power from a compatible network switch removing the need to use cumbersome DC power supplies.; An auxiliary 1GbE LAN port provides a bridged connection to the main 10G port for connecting peripherals. It can also be setup to isolate Dante audio to a separate network.; NetworkHD; Dante; AES67; API; 10GbE; PoE

sourceCatalog.quoteWarnings: 4K60 on this receiver is 4:2:0, not 4:4:4. Where 4:4:4 is required, RX-700 is the option in this family - confirm before quoting. PoH runs backwards here: the receiver powers the transmitter. Confirm the installer knows which end takes the PSU. Rated for 35m. Confirm the cable run before choosing this over RX-700. Templates offering 'RX-500 (short run) or RX-700 (long run)' present these as a distance choice only. They also differ on chroma: RX-500 is 4:2:0 at 4K60 and RX-700 is 4:4:4. That is a picture-quality difference, not just a distance one.

salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when the source, display, USB device or control point is too far away for a simple local cable.
salesLanguage.customerValue: It lets the room be built around where people and displays need to be, rather than where short cables happen to reach.
salesLanguage.realWorldApplication: Displays away from the rack, lecterns, teaching rooms, meeting rooms and point-to-point signal paths.

talkTrack: It solves a distance problem.
Use it when the video path needs reliable point-to-point extension.
It is usually simpler than AV-over-IP when the path is one source to one display.
discoveryPrompts: How far is the source from the display or USB device?
What signals need to travel over the same path?

positioningNotes: Best for defined point-to-point paths.

description: The SP-0108-SCL is a small and compact, yet powerful HDMI splitter that can be used in many applications, from digital signage, education, to retail or hospitality. Each HDMI output of the SP-0108-SCL features a 4K to 1080p down scaler, allowing for mixed resolution displays to be used simultaneously without suffering from compatibility limitations. An analog and digital S/PDIF audio de-embed allows easy connection for external amplifiers or DSPs.

wingman-sales-language-v1
SW-120-TX3: makes the room easier for presenters to use
Use this when people need to walk into a room, connect a laptop or room source, and get content onto the display without cable swapping or technical confusion.
It improves the day-to-day room experience by bringing source switching, display connection and often USB collaboration into one predictable room core.
Meeting rooms, classrooms, training spaces and collaboration rooms where users need simple presentation from modern laptops.
Talk about the user journey: connect, present, share, hand off to the display or wider system.
It can support the USB side of collaboration, so cameras, speakerphones or USB devices can be part of the room workflow.
It is strongest when the customer wants a reliable wired room experience.
HDBaseT output helps when the display or next device is away from the room core.
How many laptops or room sources need to connect?
Do users need USB devices such as a camera, speakerphone or touch display?
Are there one, two or more displays in the room?
Does the room need a feed for recording, Teams, Zoom, or AV-over-IP?
Lead with user simplicity and room workflow.
Use the port count and USB class as proof after the application is understood.
Do not sell it as a generic matrix unless the customer only cares about source-to-display routing.

Customer stakeholder
What do users need to do when they walk into the room?
What would make the room feel easier or more reliable for everyday use?
Keep the language about outcomes and the user experience before talking about ports.

Use this view when the installer needs to understand where the room core sits, which user connections land at the table or wall, and what leaves the room toward displays, USB devices or downstream systems.
Turns the sales conversation into practical install checks: location, cabling, signal direction, dependencies, control and commissioning risk.
Check the practical signal path around HDMI, USB-C, HDBaseT, DisplayPort before finalising the design.
Confirm what connects locally, what leaves the room, and which accessories or endpoints are required.
Check USB class, power method, control path and firmware notes before treating the product as a like-for-like substitute.
Where will the product physically live: table, wall, display, rack, lectern or network closet?
What cable type, distance and route are available between each endpoint?
Which products, receivers, USB devices, controllers or network switches must be present for this to work?
Good installer language should make dependencies visible before a quote is issued.
Call out install risk early when the product depends on USB bandwidth, network design, endpoint pairing or control integration.
Do not imply it is plug-and-play where cable distance, USB class, endpoint compatibility, network design or control programming still needs validation.

compatibilityReferences.note: Receiver options for SW-120-TX3; confirm 100m 4K 18Gbps and control pass-through needs.

inputs: 1 x HDMI input - 1x HDMI 19-pin type A input
1 x USB-C input - USB-C alt-mode / host, up to 60W charging
outputs: 1 x RJ45 output - 1x HDBaseT 8-pin RJ45 out to the receiver
sourceCatalog.usb: 1x Type B host (300Mbps); 3x Type A device; USB-C host with up to 60W charging
sourceCatalog.audio: 2ch audio over HDBaseT, 1-way to RX; Multichannel up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos via HDMI
sourceCatalog.control: RS-232 (3-pin Phoenix, shared, API/passthrough); CEC pass-through; 2-way PoH
dependencies: Requires a matching HDBaseT 3.0 receiver
The 60W USB-C charging needs a compatible PSU (not included)
sourceCatalog.quoteWarnings: Unlike SW-130-TX-UK (which maxes at 4K30), this HDBaseT 3.0 transmitter does reach uncompressed 4K60 4:4:4. Confirm the receiver is also HDBaseT 3.0. The RS-232 port is shared between API control and passthrough. Confirm the intended use. USB-C 60W charging requires a compatible PSU that is sold separately. Quote it if charging is needed.

name: Synergy 2-Input 4K60Hz HDBaseT 3.0 In-Wall Transmitter - WyreStorm
title: Synergy 2-Input 4K60Hz HDBaseT 3.0 In-Wall Transmitter - WyreStorm
description: 2 inputs and powerful HDBaseT 3.0 transmission result is this powerful switching transmitter, perfect for higher education classroom/hall and corporate environments. Automatic or manual switching of HDMI or USB-C and CEC power triggering via HDBaseT means a simple user experience when it matters most. Further functionality allows USB devices to be routed back to the source via USB host (or natively via USB-C) and charging for the connected USB-C device.

inputs: 2 x HDMI input - 2x HDMI in, 19-pin Type A

sourceCatalog.usb: 1x Type B host for the HDMI inputs; USB data from RX over HDBaseT
sourceCatalog.audio: 2ch PCM | multichannel up to DTS-X and Dolby Atmos; Max sampling 192KHz, max 32 channels; ARC NOT supported
sourceCatalog.control: RS-232 (4-pin Phoenix, shared with DC input); CEC one-way display trigger to RX; ALLM supported
dependencies: Requires a matching HDBaseT receiver
Compatible with the WyreStorm TS-280 touchscreen via the 4-pin Phoenix port, but only when using PoH
WyreStorm recommends shielded category cable to minimise noise and interference
sourceCatalog.quoteWarnings: This transmitter maxes at 4K@30Hz. It is NOT a 4K60 presentation path - confirm before quoting it against a 4K60 requirement. The RS-232 connector is shared with the 12V DC input on one 4-pin Phoenix. Confirm the installer knows both share the connector. ARC is not supported. Where display audio return is needed, this is not the right transmitter. TS-280 touchscreen support requires PoH - confirm the power plan if a touchscreen is in the design. Maximum is 4K@30Hz. An in-wall plate is often assumed to be a full 4K60 path; this one is not.

name: 3-Input In-wall HDBaseT Transmitter (2-gang US) - WyreStorm
title: 3-Input In-wall HDBaseT Transmitter (2-gang US) - WyreStorm
description: 3 inputs and powerful HDBaseT transmission result is this powerful switching transmitter, perfect for corporate meeting and classroom environments. Automatic or manual switching of 2 HDMI’s or USB-C and CEC power triggering via HDBaseT mean a simple user experience when it matters most. Further functionality allows USB devices to be routed back to the source via USB host (or natively via USB-C) and charging for the connected USB-C device.

summary: Synergy 4-Input 4K60Hz Presentation Switcher | USB-C 60W PD | USB-C Ethernet | 2 HDMI Matrix Outputs | USB 3.0 | Quad View | Airplay & Miracast | Wireless Presentation & Conference with APO-DG2 & APO-DG2-PRO
applications: Meeting room, classroom and BYOD presentation workflows
matrixSizeEvidence: Title evidence: 4-input presentation switcher with 2 HDMI matrix outputs

inputs: 2 x HDMI input - 19-pin type A, HDCP 1.4, up to 4K@30Hz
2 x USB-C input - Alt-mode A/V with MST, Ethernet + data, 60W PD, up to 4K@30Hz
outputs: 2 x HDMI output - Out 1: 4K@60Hz HDCP 2.2; Out 2: 4K@30Hz HDCP 1.4
dependencies: Wireless casting via APO-DG2/APO-DG2-PRO requires the dongle (sold separately), or use AirPlay/Miracast
60W USB-C PD is for host device charging
sourceCatalog.quoteWarnings: Inputs and HDMI Out 2 are HDCP 1.4 only; only HDMI Out 1 is HDCP 2.2. A protected 4K source needing HDCP 2.2 will not pass, and the two outputs are not equivalent. Input resolution is capped at 4K@30Hz (USB-C and HDMI). HDMI Out 1 reaches 4K@60Hz; Out 2 is 4K@30Hz. Assignable USB host with a built-in USB 3.0 hub - confirm which host owns the peripherals. Easy to mis-sell as a 4K60 switcher: only HDMI Out 1 reaches 4K60/HDCP 2.2; inputs and Out 2 are 4K30 and HDCP 1.4. Microsoft Teams Rooms compatibility is claimed on the page (compatible, not certified) - confirm certification for a Teams deployment.

title: Adapter Ring with USB-C, DisplayPort & Mini DisplayPort to HDMI with Cable Lock - WyreStorm
description: The WyreRing provides a simple yet effective way to ensure compatibility of BYOD in a meeting space without the need for a presentation switcher or over-specified system. The simple adapter ring provides 3 HDMI converters: USB-C, DisplayPort and Mini DisplayPort. All 3 converters support up to 4K60 video passthrough. The secure cable lock attaches to any HDMI cable up to 10mm in diameter. The metal reinforced ring provides a strong and durable connection to the converters that won’t wear out after repeated use.

name: 15 Meter USB 3.2 GEN 2 10Gbps Active Optical Extension Cable - WyreStorm
title: 15 Meter USB 3.2 GEN 2 10Gbps Active Optical Extension Cable - WyreStorm
description: The CAB-UAOC-15 is an active optical cable supporting extension of USB signals ranging from 2.0 up to the 3.2 Gen 2 spec, meaning this cable can support 10Gbps at a distance of 15 meters (50ft). The CAB-UAOC-15 is great for connection of remote USB devices such as PTZ cameras, interactive touchscreens or smartboards, audio/video extension or simply high-speed data transfer over long distances. With the USB Male to USB Female design, you can connect and extend practically any USB peripheral device in seconds.
